Behavior Score - court of law??!?
15 Oct @ 11:56pm
Father.ThySaltHeart
But how much do we know about BS, can you grind back a flag on your account ?

Behavior score pretends to measure behavior. It doesn't. It measures reports. And reports are noise.

And here's the worst part: the current system is held hostage by user input.
I'm not even getting into the BS bugs too much, but there are obvious bugs. Why is my comms in sync with my behavior at this point? When I have been through many wars and problems, how can those two scores be in sync when I was not able to communicate for over a year?

Dota 2's Behavior and Communication System Needs a Serious Rework
17 Oct @ 1:46am
Hiroshi
Originally posted by SG:
One thing that makes no sense to me is comms score being limited by behavior score. If you abandon games, you lose BS and then your punishment is that you can't communicate with your teammates, which punishes them.

Why should your comms be cut off because you abandon games? Why should your teammates be punished?

If some dude on my team can't tell me what he's doing, that punishes me.

Originally posted by Rain:
Originally posted by Rajin:
You are confusing behaviour score with comm score.
The behavior score is determined by overwatch, and only punishes you for griefing, not communication.
Me for my part, I have to say, I have griefed maybe in one game out of my 10 million games, and I instantly got an overwatch penalty.

So I have to say the overwatch thing is working perfectly fine.

The comm score on the other hand is a retarded piece of ♥♥♥♥, but comm score doesnt get you into low prio.

Comm Score Complaint Time!
6 Apr @ 11:17am
Fiveskin
You know what's ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ about the comm score? I can get muted for making a perfectly valid point. On an HG defense where the enemy has aegis, we call for HG, the bristle goes off and dies in a dark jungle it would have beeen impossible to ward.
Now im gonna have to spend another 15 games to claw back the lost comm score....FOR BEING RIGHT!

Valve needs to switch back to a standard mute system. The current system over punishes people and caters to people who not only are idiots, but also mute people for making valid points.

Originally posted by Touki:
Originally posted by Azure:
While League of Legends employs advanced verification protocols to mitigate the impact of fraudulent reporting, Dota 2’s behavioral & communication score system remains fundamentally flawed, exacerbated by the inherent subjectivity and lack of expertise within the Overwatch adjudicators...
It has no more*
